correctness.rationale: For finite monotone F:P(W)->P(W), each minimal truth support is an antichain, and w in F(S) iff a minimal support at w lies in S. Under exactly two incomparable supports at each w and w in each support, an S5 partition pair forces support stability and a bipartite incidence multigraph H. Conversely a proper two-coloring of H yields two partitions: stable support membership forces equal-colored blocks disjoint, while each world has one of each. There are exactly 2^c colorings for c components and 2^(c-1) classes after a global swap. Incomparability forces each connected component to contain at least four worlds, so c<=floor(n/4); disjoint 2x2 grids attain sharpness. A stable three-world support triangle gives a nonrepresentable odd-cycle boundary, and two grids on eight worlds give first global-swap ambiguity. The proof covers n>=4 represented cases and correctly excludes n<4.

originality.rationale: The novel object is the COMPLETE truth-set operator on the SAME world carrier and the entire fiber of ordered pairs of equivalence relations. Ding-Yang 2026 (Section 5.1 Lemma 5.5) gives existence via enlarged-world unraveling and not same-carrier identification. Agotnes-Wang 2021 relates anonymous knowledge to neighborhoods but does not visibly count the fixed-carrier partition fiber. Published quadratic proper S5 cover theorem concerns m^2-state bounded morphism for a UNIVERSAL target; it is not a classification of fixed-carrier operator ambiguity. Different direction of reduction and different carrier are essential.
